hypothesis: Changing only the native output grammar prevents definite-intent/null-quote failures; attribution prompt, intent prompt, source parser and fixed model stay unchanged.
scope: Developer-authored exploratory set. New questions were not used in preceding runs, but are not an external blind benchmark.
